priorityList: Cast Ferocious Bite / Ravage with an Apex Predator's Craving proc.
Cast Tiger's Fury on cooldown – Aim to use alongside 5 Combo Points, or when 50 Energy below your cap.
Cast Berserk on cooldown. Sync with Tiger's Fury.
Cast Convoke the Spirits on cooldown. Always line up with Berserk.
Cast Rip with 5 Combo Points if it's not active, or in Pandemic range – Aim to only apply/refresh this with Tiger's Fury active when possible.
Cast Ferocious Bite / Ravage with 5 Combo Points and Rip applied.
Cast Shred with Sudden Ambush active.
Cast Rake if it's not active on your target, or within Pandemic range.
Cast Shred to build Combo Points.
Cast Ferocious Bite with Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Cast Rip if it is missing on the target.
Cast Rip if it is in Pandemic and you have 5 Combo Points.
Cast Ferocious Bite if you have 4 or more Combo Points, 25 or greater energy, and Rip is active.
